biased_nodes.label: Python

The system is likely weighting the established web development skills higher than the demonstrable data science skills, potentially overlooking the candidate's underlying potential. A correction factor of 1.25 reflects this potential bias, acknowledging the strength of the web development experience but urging an increased consideration of the candidate's core data science capabilities.
